title: My Stepdaughter Forged The Title, Sold My Diner, And Mailed Me $3,500. So I Let The Ink Confess.
description: I drained my $96,000 nursing pension to restore a 1952 Mountain View diner car and open a milkshake bar with my stepdaughter. She forged the title, sold the diner and recipes for $650,000, and mailed me a $3,500 check as a 'tip.' I found the original partnership agreement in the jukebox, proved the forgery, and now she scrubs chrome in a 'Grilled My Trust' shirt while every receipt prints her perjury case number. #KarmaServed #DinerBetrayal #FamilyRevenge
thumb_text: SHE FORGED THE TITLE, NOW WEARS 'GRILLED MY TRUST'
pinned_comment: If your stepdaughter had forged the title, sold your dream diner, and mailed you a $3,500 'tip,' what would you have done when you found the original agreement? Tell me your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I FOUND THE ORIGINAL AGREEMENT HIDDEN IN A 1950S JUKEBOX
